response: Concomitant anterior/apical repair during midurethral sling does not result in additional improvement in overactive bladder symptoms for women with mixed urinary incontinence. In fact, patients who experience postoperative complications tend to exhibit less improvement in overactive bladder symptoms. Therefore, the use of concomitant anterior/apical repair during midurethral sling placement does not provide significant benefits for the overactive bladder component of mixed incontinence.
